what: layered template: 11 layers cut from archive f006 by bone-Voronoi over the SAM mask
saw: head, torso, tail and four two-segment legs separate cleanly; f006 chosen over f008 because its tail is visible and all four legs are apart

what: fit v1: soft-silhouette + keypoint render loss at 192x144, finite-difference least_squares, sequential over 50 frames
saw: IoU 0.82-0.91 on profile frames, but ~50-280 s per frame on the shared machine (load 12-21); frames 19-25 fall to IoU 0.2-0.6
decision: killed at frame 25 (no params saved); rewrote as resumable chunks at 96x72, one BLAS thread

what: provisional render with the f006 texture only (no learned model) to test stage, person, IK and timing
saw: door leaf hinged on the far jamb covered the lit room; the template head held high reads as howling; lying reads; front view of the turn is a leg tangle
decision: hinge on the near jamb, brighter room, head neutral lowered, far legs fade toward front view

what: fit v2: two chunks (0->24 forward, 49->25 backward)
saw: front and right-facing frames (26-49) stuck in local minima: tail outside the mask, head on the wrong end, IoU 0.40-0.55
decision: multi-start (tail hung down, head lowered, both mirror states) + a sigma-4 blur level for a wider basin

what: fit v3 for frames 17-49 with multi-start
saw: IoU 0.55-0.85 (mean all 50: 0.73 at 96x72); front frames 26-32 fit 0.75-0.85; head on 43-47 (dog lowering its head to the bowl) still poorly placed; 19-25 masks swallow the shadow
decision: exclude 19-25 by eye from learning (23, 49 also flagged by mask area); keep

what: learn: view latent, view regression of shape, view-binned appearance atlases (w^2 kernel), held-out evaluation
saw: held-out MAE 0.093 learned vs 0.107 single-drawing rig vs 0.098 drawing swap; atlases blurry grey averages, tail low-confidence everywhere

what: atlas kernel w^4 (nearest views dominate) + larger joint caps on knees
saw: held-out MAE 0.098 (slightly worse than w^2, still below the rig 0.107, equal to swap); knee gaps closed; texture marginally crisper
decision: keep w^4 for the film (visual), report both numbers

what: model raw failures at generated poses
saw: (a) front view: foreshortening only x stands the head upright (giraffe); (b) look back over the shoulder: the reflected head kept its unreflected tilt and pointed at the sky; (c) look in: x-foreshortening of an up-left head makes it point up, and the model cannot tell a head turned away from one turned toward us
decision: corrections: head tipped toward camera with psi_h, reflected tilt for reflected head, look-in muzzle levelled + face shadowed; learned head tilt from the view regression now applied

saw: I1 failed at retreat->watch (my bbox-height criterion caught gait bob at 1.83 s); after measuring the top of the dog instead: all onsets within 0.17 s; ALL OK

what: person at the end faced away from the dog at the sill; offered hand rested on the knee
saw: the hand did not read as offered; the person sat with its back to the dog after it passed
decision: hand reaches lower and further; the silhouette turns toward the door 21.9-22.5 s (scaled through edge-on); re-render all
